messages:
Alex S (Support): Flagging P1 onboarding stall for NexaHealth trial — activation stuck on 'processing' for 48h. Provisioning requests to /v1/keys return 502. Support ticket #4351. @Priya R can you take CS handoff + comms? Logs pasted below.

deploy-bot: Incident created: #INC-4321 linked to ticket #4351 — severity P1. Assigned to eng oncall.

Priya R (CSM): On it. What's the renewal window? Are they on Dedicated or Hosted?

Alex S (Support): Hosted. Trial ends in 9 days. They've got ~12k tokens used. Customer is on a PoC with key delivery automation.

Jordan L (Solutions): Quick note — support tried key rotation and retried provisioning; still 502. Suspect quota throttle on regional pool. If so, we can switch them to fallback pool for immediate recovery.

Sam T (Eng): Investigating now. Saw similar 502s tied to a recent autoscaler race; checking logs (commit 4f3b2c). ETA 2h for rollback/hotfix. In meantime can route them to fallback model: model=redwood-small-v2-fallback

Priya R (CSM): I'll prep a customer-facing update. Drafting message:

"Hi Alex, we're seeing a provisioning issue affecting trial activation; engineering is working on a fix. As a temporary step we've enabled a fallback route so your trial features should resume shortly. We'll follow up with confirmation and timeline in 2 hours. — Priya"

Casey M (CS Manager): Good. Add expected user impact and two actions: 1) temporary workaround enabled, 2) full fix ETA. Also include contact for exec escalation.

Alex S (Support): Confirmed I enabled fallback route for this tenant, status=partial_ok.

Priya R (CSM): Sending message to customer now. Copying support notes and runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/onboard-provisioning

Sam T (Eng): Hotfix deployed to regional pool, monitoring. Error was autoscaler contention; reduced min replicas and patched. Rolling window 30m.

Priya R (CSM): Customer update sent (ticket #4351): "Fallback enabled, fix in progress, monitoring — next update in 30m." :thumbsup:

Casey M (CS Manager): Follow-up checklist:
- Priya: send calendar invite for handoff demo (if needed)
- Alex: add troubleshooting notes to ticket
- Sam: verify rollback metrics at +30m
- Jordan: prepare enablement doc for NexaHealth's infra team

Alex S (Support): Added notes. Ticket updated.

Sam T (Eng): Metrics look stable, 2xx responses returning. I'll close INC-4321 once 60m of stability.

Priya R (CSM): Closing handoff on Slack — will escalate to AE if any risk to renewal. Thanks team. :heart:
